meta.name: branches
meta.description: Create and name git branches following project conventions. Use when creating branches, checking out new branches, or the user mentions branch naming.

copy.tagline: 按项目规范自动创建和命名 git 分支
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要按团队规范创建 git 分支
copy.tagline_en: Create and name git branches following project conventions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to create git branches following team conventions

howto.what: 安装后，当你请求创建或切换 Git 分支时，Claude 会按照项目约定的格式（如 feature/RI-123/add-user-profile）自动命名分支，并确保类型、问题号和标题都正确。
howto.when: 当你要求创建新分支、检出分支，或提到分支命名时触发。

say.text: 创建 release 分支 v2.0.0。

howto.what_en: When you ask Claude to create or switch a Git branch, it will automatically name the branch following the project's convention (e.g., feature/RI-123/add-user-profile) with correct type, issue reference, and short title.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create a new branch, checkout a branch, or mention branch naming.

say_en.text: Create a feature branch for JIRA RI-123, adding user profile.
Create a bugfix branch for GitHub issue 789, fixing connection timeout.
